verdict.rationale: Warp is itself an agentic coding/terminal product (agent role); all MCP-related evidence (warp-docs-7, warp-docs-18, warp-docs-37, warp-docs-52) describes Warp's agents *connecting to* external MCP servers as a client, not Warp exposing an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the client-vs-server distinction, this makes the 'connect an agent via an official MCP server' (server role) axis inapplicable to Warp.
